summary: Danaher Corporation filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of Julie Sawyer Montgomery as President and CEO, effective October 1, 2026, and her election to the Board and committees. This is a planned executive transition, not a forced departure. The filing includes no deal terms or special-situation mechanics. The event is the leadership change itself, with clarity on effective date and board roles. What to watch: any strategic shifts under new leadership and continuity with prior CEO.
